problem: Prove that among any n+1 distinct integers chosen from the set {1, 2, ..., 2n}, there are two that are coprime.

problem_spans.reason: One more pick than n boxes: the classic pigeonhole count.
No repeats, so each pick occupies its own slot.
Universe of size 2n splits into n natural pairs.
Only one pair is needed, not a full structure.
Goal is gcd 1, which consecutive integers always satisfy.
